description: Extract structured data from a URL or raw text into strict JSON matching a schema you provide. Fields the content doesn't support come back null - never an invented or approximate value, and an unmatchable schema returns an explicit error. Try GET /extract/sample. Part of the AgentIndex content kit (pdf, web-read, extract, summarize, detect-language) - see GET /capabilities.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the fields to extract. The response's `data` field will strictly conform to it.

text.description: Raw text to extract from. Provide this or url, not both.

url.description: URL to read and extract from. Provide this or text, not both.

name: extract_structured

data.description: Extracted data, matching the requested schema's shape - fields the content doesn't support come back null rather than an invented value (see missing_fields).

missing_fields.description: Top-level keys in data the model could not find in the content and returned as null.

x402_receipt.description: Billing and provenance receipt for this call.

title: Extract Structured Data
